note: T-110 felt surface (presets/4). Every id extends one presets/1..3 id (that preset's own resolved data, unchanged) with an optional patch and a 'halo' section for the one shared Geometry Nodes fibre halo (felt_halo.py, PS Felt Halo/1). Opt-in only: a spec gets the halo and the patch by naming a /4 id in an assignment; every presets/1..3 id builds exactly as before. Halo: density per cm2 and length in mm at the library reference size (scaled with reference_size_m like the surface fibres), spread (tilt, 0..1 of 80 deg), opacity, facing_floor (opacity factor where the surface faces the camera; 1 at the silhouette), silhouette_power, tip_transparency, colour = the assignment base colour x color_value (HSV value) and x color_saturation, radius_fraction (root radius / length), lod (density factor for the wide LOD).

felt skin/4.description: Felt skin (T-110): skin-felt/3 made less plastic. Rougher, lower specular, a lighter and shorter subsurface (no waxy glow on thin hands), a broader dye-tinted felt sheen, a stronger fine felt micro-surface and flock, plus a very fine, short peach fibre halo that shows only at the silhouette (cheeks, ears, hands). Non-emissive.

hoodie fleece/4.description: hoodie fleece/3 + the shared felt halo: the bright, even fibre halo at the hoodie silhouette (B08, 01 closeups).

trouser pile/4.description: trouser pile/3 + the shared felt halo: a short, quiet halo on the dark joggers (01 closeups).

felt/4.description: felt + the shared felt halo (shoes, backpack, felt details, hair accessories).

felt hair/4.description: felt hair + the shared felt halo: a lighter, wispy fibre halo at the hair edges (01 closeups, ref_30).

vest felt/4.description: vest felt/3 + the shared felt halo: a short, uniform fuzz halo on the pressed felt vest (G07, ref_42).

brushed cotton/4.description: brushed cotton/3 + the shared felt halo, kept very short and sparse (blouse and shorts are cloth, ref_42).

cuff fleece/4.description: cuff fleece/3 + the shared felt halo: a longer, soft halo on the cream sherpa cuffs (G08).

boot fleece/4.description: boot fleece + the shared felt halo (G08 boots).
